67. Regarding the expansion of India's Semiconductor Mission (ISM), consider the following statements:
A. The mission provides financial incentives to establish semiconductor fabs and display fabs in India.
B. It supports design-linked incentive (DLI) schemes for domestic startups working on semiconductor design.
C. The initiative aims to position India as a key hub in global electronics supply chains.

10. Regarding the application of the ‘creamy layer’ concept to Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) in 2026, the Supreme Court’s stance emphasizes which of the following principles?
(1) Exclusion of advanced individuals within
SC/ST categories to ensure reservation
benefits reach the most marginalized
(2) Complete and permanent exclusion of all
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes from
affirmative action policies in public sector
employment
(3) Universal application of strict economic
income criteria for affirmative action

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that the Supreme Court emphasizes the exclusion of advanced individuals within SC/ST categories to ensure reservation benefits reach the most marginalized. Supreme Court jurisprudence emphasizes identifying advanced individuals within reserved categories to ensure affirmative action benefits reach truly underprivileged groups. Applying creamy layer principles within Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes aims to prevent disproportionate monopolization of benefits by socio-economically advanced members. This approach seeks to distribute constitutional reservations equitably, fulfilling substantive equality objectives while maintaining social justice principles across affirmative action policies.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का रुख SC/ST श्रेणियों के भीतर उन्नत व्यक्तियों के बहिष्कार पर जोर देता है ताकि आरक्षण लाभ सबसे हाशिए पर रहने वालों तक पहुंचे। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की न्यायशास्त्र उन्नत व्यक्तियों की पहचान पर जोर देती है ताकि सकारात्मक कार्रवाई के लाभ वास्तव में वंचित समूहों तक पहुँच सकें। अनुसूचित जातियों और अनुसूचित जनजातियों में क्रीमी लेयर सिद्धांतों का अनुप्रयोग लाभों के असमान वितरण को रोकने के लिए है। यह दृष्टिकोण संवैधानिक आरक्षण को समान रूप से वितरित करने का प्रयास करता है, जो कि सामाजिक न्याय के सिद्धांतों को बनाए रखते हुए सामग्री समानता के लक्ष्यों को पूरा करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Exclusion of advanced individuals within SC/ST categories to ensure reservation benefits reach the most marginalized.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Supreme Court jurisprudence emphasizes identifying advanced individuals within reserved categories to ensure affirmative action benefits reach truly underprivileged groups.
